name: Jolly Roger RV Resort
note: Runs from US-1 to Florida Bay on Grassy Key, with a boat basin, ramp and rental slips. An online booking reserves a site class, not a site number. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site jrtp.com read 2026-10-30 (RV sites page: full-hookup 30/50-amp sites in Interior / Interior Plus / Premium / Seawall classes, daily, weekly and monthly rates, phone 305-289-0404) and its RezExpert engine (online.rezexpert.com/book?business_code=300423), which on 2026-10-30 sold a 23-ft motorhome one night on Tue Dec 8 2026 with 113 sites available, and one night on Tue Feb 16 2027 (one site left, the rest booked, no minimum message); Good Sam directory types it RV_PARK (a Good Sam Park), not a condo park; Google Maps open, 4.6/1,138, phone matches -> real transient RV resort; price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator's booking engine sells SEAWALL back-in sites 'right along the Gulf of Mexico' and motorhome-only SEAWALL HARBOR sites over Tiki Island; that claim only triggered the audit. The Esri satellite (sat.py, rendered: 500 m frame at 24.7718,-80.9435 and 180 m frame at 24.7714,-80.9418) shows the park's NE edge as a straight seawall on open Florida Bay (open salt water to the horizon, not a canal or channel), with a row of RVs parked on the paved strip directly against the seawall, roughly 3-5 m from pad to water, and the park road behind them, so nothing separates those pads from the bay. The boat basin at the NW corner is a short dredged harbor opening straight onto the bay; it is not needed for the call. Interior, Interior Plus and Premium rows sit inland behind the seawall row.
fees_source: RezExpert engine online.rezexpert.com/book?business_code=300423, read 2026-10-30, 23-ft motorhome, 2 adults, 1 night Tue Dec 8 2026: INTERIOR '1 Day(s)@132.00' + Reservation Fee 4.46, before 12.5% state/county tax and 7.5% sales tax on the fee (grand total $153.29); the same night INTERIOR PLUS totalled $161.42, PREMIUM $166.07, SEAWALL $168.39 (backs out to about $145 base). Tue Feb 16 2027 INTERIOR PLUS totalled $161.42 (same as December). jrtp.com/rv-sites posts summer and winter daily $125-145 before 12.5% tax. The quote carried no resort or grounds fee.
flags: Cheapest in-season night is $132 before tax (Interior, Dec 2026); the website posts $125-145 daily in both seasons, and a summer special runs Interior sites at $75 a night through Nov 15 (6 nights max).

Extra charges: a non-refundable 3% online reservation fee (the $4.46 'Reservation Fee' on a $132 night) and a 3% credit-card surcharge (debit exempt). The engine's terms also mention an 'applicable resort fee' in the deposit, but no resort fee appeared in the quote.
No minimum stay: single nights quoted in December and mid-February. Peak February is nearly sold out (one site free on a Tuesday in Feb 2027).
No total site count is published; 113 RV sites were free for one night on Tue Dec 8 2026, so far more than 1 in 10 are sold by the night. Weekly and monthly rates also exist.
Good Sam Park (isGsPark true, military true) per the Good Sam directory cache.
RV Life shows 9.2/10 from 293 reviews (given as 4.6*); the candidate record carried no star value.
